name: gemma-4-31b-it-fp8
summary: Jul 2026 dense 31B: 50 sliding-window (1,024) + 10 global attention layers, Red Hat FP8-dynamic; plain attention, so prefix caching is mature

hf.quant: FP8 dynamic, compressed-tensors (Red Hat); the vision tower stays BF16

evidence: Not served. Publisher reports Tau2 76.9 (model card, 2026-10-03); shortlist signals only.
caveats: The global layers set attention_k_eq_v; the fit counts K and V separately, so its KV per token may be up to 2× high
